evidence.title: A Phase 3b, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate Retatrutide Treatment in the Maintenance of Weight Reduction in Individuals With Obesity
evidence.text: This is a study of retatrutide in participants with obesity. The main purpose is to learn more about how retatrutide maintains body weight loss. The study will have two treatment phases: an 80 week lead-in phase in which all participants will take retatrutide dose 1 and a 36 week randomized, double-blinded phase in which participants will either take retatrutide dose 1, retatrutide dose 2, or switch to placebo. Participation in the study will last around 125 weeks.

evidence.text: Population and eligibility for trial NCT06859268 (A Study of Retatrutide (LY3437943) in the Maintenance of Weight Reduction in Individuals With Obesity). Eligible population: not stated. Sex: ALL; age: 18 Years to not stated; healthy volunteers: not stated.
